name: ForwardOrder
description: Prepare forwarding a sales order to another user. Bot shows a confirm card with recipient picker; ownership transfers only after the user confirms. Call when the user wants to hand over, transfer, reassign, forward, or delegate an order. Call with order_id even if the recipient is not stated. When a recipient is stated, pass forward_to_user (include honorifics as-is).

order_id.description: The unique sales order identifier in SAP (e.g., '5', '8' or '0000005001') to be forwarded. Must be explicitly stated by the user.

forward_to_user.description: Optional suggested recipient: SAP id, name, or email. Used to pre-select on the confirm card when it matches a linked user. Null/omit if unknown — bot shows the picker.
